verses.he: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל־שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃
verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is riotous; And whosoever reeleth thereby is not wise.

verses.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: He that provoketh him to anger forfeiteth his life.

verses.he: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל־אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: It is an honour for a man to keep aloof from strife; But every fool will be snarling.

verses.he: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ ישאל [וְשָׁאַ֖ל] בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.en: The sluggard will not plow when winter setteth in; Therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; But a man of understanding will draw it out. .

verses.he: רָב־אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness; But a faithful man who can find?

verses.he: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He that walketh in his integrity as a just man, Happy are his children after him.

verses.he: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כָּל־רָֽע׃
verses.en: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment Scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

verses.he: מִֽי־יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: Who can say: ‘I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin’?

verses.he: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, Both of them alike are abomination to the LORD.

verses.he: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָ֑עַר אִם־זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, Whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.he: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, The LORD hath made even both of them.

verses.he: אַל־תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; Open thine eyes, and thou shalt have bread in plenty.

verses.he: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.en: ’It is bad, it is bad’, saith the buyer; But when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

verses.he: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרָב־פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies; But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.he: לְֽקַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נכרים [נָכְרִיָּ֣ה] חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge that is surety for an alien woman.

verses.he: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא־פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃
verses.en: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.he: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel; And with good advice carry on war.

verses.he: גּֽוֹלֶה־סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets; Therefore meddle not with him that openeth wide his lips.

verses.he: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ באישון [בֶּאֱשׁ֥וּן] חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, His lamp shall be put out in the blackest darkness.

verses.he: נַ֭חֲלָה מבחלת [מְבֹהֶ֣לֶת] בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.en: An estate may be gotten hastily at the beginning; But the end thereof shall not be blessed.

verses.he: אַל־תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Say not thou: ‘I will requite evil’; Wait for the LORD, and He will save thee.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination to the LORD; And a false balance is not good.

verses.he: מֵיְהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה־יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A man’s goings are of the LORD; How then can man look to his way?

verses.he: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.en: It is a snare to a man rashly to say: ‘Holy’, And after vows to make inquiry.

verses.he: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃
verses.en: A wise king sifteth the wicked, And turneth the wheel over them.

verses.he: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD, Searching all the inward parts.

verses.he: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king; And his throne is upheld by mercy.

verses.he: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength; And the beauty of old men is the hoary head.

verses.he: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריק [תַּמְר֣וּק] בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: Sharp wounds cleanse away evil; So do stripes that reach the inward parts.
